findings.evidence: The three proofs at the start of the Measure section are identical apart from `map_add`/`map_smul`/`map_zero`. FirstJet/Basic.lean:595-622 has only neighbourhood (`=ᶠ[𝓝 _]`) versions of these facts.
findings.fix: Factor out a lemma for the measurability of that domain set, or pointwise `localRep_add`/`localRep_smul`/`localRep_zero` lemmas on it, alongside the existing `localRep_*_eventuallyEq` in FirstJet/Basic.lean. Then derive the three closure lemmas from it in one line each.
findings.issue: `LocallyIntegrableSection.add`, `.smul` and `.zero` each repeat the same `ae_restrict_iff' ((isChartMeasurable_def _).1 ((trivializationAt G W α).open_baseSet.isChartMeasurable (I := I)) α)` / `ae_of_all` / `apply_eq_prod_continuousLinearEquivAt` block. This hides the reusable fact that the reading domain `(extChartAt I α).target ∩ (extChartAt I α).symm ⁻¹' baseSet` is measurable and that `localRep` is linear on it.

findings.evidence: The duplicated `mono_set` expression appears in both the `hi` binding and the final `exact` of `integrableDensity_and_integralDensity_eq_sum`, and again in the `hloc` binding of `chartDistributionCLM_ofSection_apply_apply`.
findings.fix: Add a private lemma `LocallyIntegrableSection.locallyIntegrableOn_target (hu) (c) (hct) (hcα) : LocallyIntegrableOn (localRep I G u α) c.target _` and use it at all three sites.
findings.issue: In `integrableDensity_and_integralDensity_eq_sum`, the term `(hu.locallyIntegrableOn α).mono_set (target_subset_inter_preimage_baseSet (A.chart α) (hA α) (hAα α))` is written out twice, once in `hi` and once in the final `Finset.sum_congr`. The same restriction is rebuilt as `hloc` in `chartDistributionCLM_ofSection_apply_apply`.

summary: The proofs are short and every defeq `rfl` is commented, but the same ae-restriction and measurability argument appears three times in `LocallyIntegrableSection.add`/`.smul`/`.zero`, and that duplication hides a reusable fact. The same mono_set argument is also written out twice inside `integrableDensity_and_integralDensity_eq_sum`.
